derivative.description: Independent straight trousers derived from the licensed lower-body topology and rig. Plane-clipped waist and ankle boundaries create level hems; added cloth clearance, knee folds, a waistband, pressed front creases and turned cuffs create a distinct tailored silhouette. Interpolated boundary vertices preserve blended joint influences and normalized weights.
derivative.runtime: Loaded locally as glTF 2.0, rebound to identically named VRM bones and recolored by the selected wardrobe item.
